title: Data Manifest Schema
description: Strict schema for data_manifest.json defining required fields for scientific data sources.

sources.description: List of data sources included in the manifest.

source_id.description: Unique identifier for the source within the project context.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier if available. Null if not applicable.

url.description: Direct URL to the data source if available. Null if not applicable.

checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of the downloaded file for integrity verification. Null if not yet computed.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the source.

access_date.description: Date the data was accessed in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

generated_at.description: Timestamp of manifest generation in ISO 8601 format.
